title: chore(claude): allow a cloud seat to create and push its mailbox branch
body:
Closes #38074

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: ruled
Ruling-ref: the maintainer, verbatim in the security#2 session on 2026-11-28 (recorded on the card's Source line): 「在仓库的 .claude/settings.json 里加一条允许规则再提交。立卡」, then 「立卡并派发」.

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:云端值班席位开信箱时,自建信箱分支的提交与推送在自动模式下不再弹审批。
- 为什么做:让每个云端值班席位在自动模式下自己就能坐席,不必等账号主人切模式。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是信箱分支的推送不再经审批;改动只在两条精确写法上放行,撤回即删这几行。
- 要你做什么:审阅后亲自合并这个草稿 PR。

## What changes

`.claude/settings.json`:

- `permissions.allow` gains two entries:
  ```
  "Bash(git commit --allow-empty -F *)",
  "Bash(git push -u origin claude/mailbox-*)"
  ```
- `permissions.ask` gains three entries scoped to those two rules, so that only the bare forms run without approval. Ask takes precedence over allow.
  ```
  "Bash(git commit --allow-empty -F * *)",
  "Bash(git push -u origin claude/mailbox-* *)",
  "Bash(git push -u origin claude/mailbox-*:*)"
  ```

`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`:

- The refusal printed when the default branch's push is refused (a cloud seat) moves into a pure exported `pushRefusedMessage(plan, status)` and now names the three commands, one per line, spelt as the allow rules above, then keeps the `--head` re-run:
  ```
  git switch -c claude/mailbox-SLUG origin/main
  git commit --allow-empty -F FILE
  git push -u origin claude/mailbox-SLUG
  then pass --head claude/mailbox-SLUG (--close deletes that name) ...
  ```
- The self-test pins it: one new case in the open-plan battery (floor 13 to 14) asserts the five lines, the three commands verbatim for seat `domain:ui#4`, the `--head` line and the exit status.

## Why

The relay has no ref-creating op, so a cloud seat must create one empty commit on `origin/main` and push it to `claude/mailbox-SLUG` itself. In an auto-mode cloud session no allow rule covered that commit or push: on 2026-11-28 the classifier denied the push from the security#2 seat three times, once after the maintainer had approved it in chat, and the seat could only sit after the session was switched out of Auto mode. The card-branch forms already had this shape (#35443); mailbox branches had no equivalent. The maintainer merges this PR himself.

## Reach

- **Runs without approval:** exactly `git commit --allow-empty -F FILE` and `git push -u origin claude/mailbox-SLUG`, the forms the refusal now names.
- **Still asks:** anything after the message file (for example `-a`, `--amend`, `-n`, `--no-verify` or a pathspec), anything after the mailbox branch (a second refspec, a tag, a force, delete, prune or mirror flag, `--no-verify`), and a `src:dst` refspec on the mailbox branch.
- **Spelling:** a message file path containing a space also asks, because the matcher reads the space as "something after". A commit or push spelt any other way (`-m`, a bare `git push`, `--allow-empty` after `-F`) still asks, as today.
- **Chained lines:** a line that starts with either allowed form and continues (the commit chained to the push, or the push piped into `tail`) asks, because ask rules are tried against the whole line. The refusal prints each command on its own line for this reason.
- **The switch:** `git switch -c claude/mailbox-SLUG origin/main` gains no rule here (the card names none); it is a local branch creation and is not what the classifier denied.
- **Other sessions:** every rule starts with the allowed command's own prefix, so no push or commit outside these forms changes behaviour. The existing `git commit -F *` allow does not match `git commit --allow-empty -F ...`, since the prefix differs.
- **Unchanged:** `main`'s ruleset, the `deny` roster (17 GitHub content-write tools) and the hooks, including `check:commit-card-trailers`, which still judges the mailbox commit's trailer pair.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/check-settings-deny-roster.mjs` passes locally.
- The file parses as JSON.
- `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` passes with the reworded refusal pinned.
